trace.msg: Let's look at this puzzle carefully. I'll only move when I can explain why.
Going left would force the line onto number 6 before its turn; going down would force the line onto number 6 before its turn (and 1 more option fails too). So the line goes right.
I can't rule out up or right yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up.

Going left leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes up.
Going up, the next move is forced and the line gets stuck at cell (1,2); going left leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes right.
Number 4 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going up would leave number 5 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes down.
Going right, the next 2 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (5,4). So the line goes down.
Going down leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes right.

Going to number 5 would leave both cell (6,4) and cell (6,6) needing the line next, and it can't do both; going up would leave number 5 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes right.
The line must go down: up is number 9, which comes later.
